description: §41.4 / §41.3.1 — a subpath specifier `scrml:auth/jwt` names the stdlib submodule stdlib/auth/jwt.scrml, which exports `JwtError`; the import resolves cleanly (no E-IMPORT-004, no E-IMPORT-006). The twin of the submodule-only-name reject case.
rationale: §41.4's protocol-prefix table lists `scrml:utils/string` as a `scrml:` specifier, so `scrml:<module>/<sub>` is a module path, resolved against the stdlib (§41.5) and judged against that submodule's own export list (§21.3 via §41.3.1).
